function.name: generate_image_tool
function.description: Generates an image based on the provided description and saves it with the specified file name. The image description should be detailed to ensure the resulting image matches the desired subject and surroundings; otherwise, these aspects will be chosen randomly. This function is not intended for generating images from textual data. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

desc.description: A single string that provides a detailed description of the desired image. For example, 'a sunset over the mountains with a lake in the foreground'.

file_name.description: The name of the file to which the generated image will be saved. It should include the file extension, such as 'image.png'.

function.name: tts_tool
function.description: Converts the provided text content to speech and saves the resulting audio to a file. This function is intended for voice narration and should be used accordingly. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

content.description: The text content that needs to be converted to speech.

speaker.description: The voice to be used for the text-to-speech conversion.

file_name.description: The name of the file to save the audio output without the extension. If left empty, a default name will be generated based on the content.

function.name: write_markdown_tool
function.description: Writes the provided content to a Markdown (.md) file on the disk. This function should be used when there is a need to persist text data in Markdown format as a result of a user action or a process that requires saving information in a structured text file. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

content.description: The Markdown formatted text content to be written to the file.

filename.description: The name of the file to which the Markdown content will be written. If not provided, a default filename will be used.

function.name: write_html_tool
function.description: Writes an HTML file to disk with the given content. Ensures HTML tags within the content are properly closed. This function should be used when there is a need to save HTML content to a file as part of a 'save' operation. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

content.description: The HTML content to be written to the file. Must contain valid HTML structure.

filename.description: The name of the file to which the HTML content will be written. If not provided, a default filename will be used.

function.name: search_web_tool
function.description: Executes a search query using the DuckDuckGo search engine and returns a specified number of search results from a given source. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search term or phrase to be queried.

num_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return. A positive integer.

source.description: The source from which the search results should be fetched.

function.name: get_url_content
function.description: Scrapes the specified URL for textual data and returns the content as a string. This function is useful for extracting information from web pages when a URL is provided. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The web address of the page to scrape. It should be a valid URL format, such as 'http://www.example.com'.

timeout.description: The maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, with a default value that allows for a reasonable amount of time for most web pages to load.

user_agent.description: The User-Agent string to be used for the HTTP request to simulate a particular browser, which is optional. Some websites may require this for access.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the most common “tools” (websites, apps, APIs, and services) you can use to book flights:

| Category | Tool / Service | What it does | Typical Use‑Case |
|----------|----------------|--------------|------------------|
| **Online Travel Agencies (OTAs)** | **Expedia** | Aggregates flights, hotels, car rentals, and packages. | One‑stop booking for multi‑service trips. |
| | **Kayak** | Flight comparison engine; shows price trends and alerts. | Finding the cheapest fare across many airlines. |
| | **Skyscanner** | Global flight search with flexible dates and destinations. | Budget travelers looking for the best deal. |
| | **Google Flights** | Fast search, price graph, and “Explore” map. | Quick price checks and itinerary planning. |
| | **Momondo** | Similar to Skyscanner but often finds slightly cheaper fares. | Alternative search engine for cross‑checking. |
| | **Priceline** | Known for “Name Your Own Price” and Express Deals. | Last‑minute or discounted bookings. |
| | **Orbitz** | OTA with rewards program. | Frequent travelers who want points. |
| | **Travelocity** | OTA with a focus on customer service. | Travelers who prefer a dedicated support line. |
| | **Hotwire** | Offers “Hot Rate” deals for flights, hotels, and cars. | Bargain hunting for flexible travel. |
| | **CheapOair** | Focuses on low‑fare flights and package deals. | Budget travelers seeking discounts. |
| | **Trip.com** | Chinese OTA with global reach, often cheaper in Asia. | Travelers in or to Asia. |
| | **Booking.com** | Primarily hotels, but also offers flight booking. | One‑stop for accommodation + flight. |
| | **Airbnb Experiences** | Not a flight booking tool, but sometimes bundles flights with local experiences. | Experiential travel. |
| **Airline Direct Sites** | **Delta, United, American, Southwest, JetBlue, Alaska, Air Canada, Qantas, Emirates, Lufthansa, etc.** | Book directly with the airline. | Loyalty points, seat selection, baggage options. |
| | **Low‑Cost Carriers** (e.g., Ryanair, EasyJet, Spirit, Frontier, Wizz Air, AirAsia, Scoot) | Direct booking on budget carriers. | Cheapest fares, but often no free checked bags. |
| **Mobile Apps** | **Google Trips** (now integrated into Google Travel) | Manage itineraries, flight status, and reservations. | On‑the‑go itinerary management. |
| | **TripIt** | Organizes travel plans into a single itinerary. | Consolidating multiple bookings. |
| | **Hopper** | Predicts future prices and tells you when to buy. | Timing your purchase for best price. |
| | **FlightRadar24** | Real‑time flight tracking. | Checking flight status and delays. |
| | **FlightAware** | Flight tracking and status alerts. | Monitoring flight changes. |
| | **Airfarewatchdog** | Alerts for price drops on specific routes. | Price drop notifications. |
| | **Skiplagged** | Finds hidden‑city ticketing options. | Advanced fare‑hunting (note: airlines frown upon this). |
| **API & SDK Solutions** | **Amadeus for Developers** | Flight search, booking, and ancillary services. | Integrating flight booking into custom apps. |
| | **Sabre API** | Comprehensive travel booking platform. | Enterprise travel agencies. |
| | **Travelport API** | Global distribution system (GDS) for flights, hotels, etc. | Large‑scale travel solutions. |
| | **Kiwi.com API** | Multi‑carrier itineraries and dynamic packaging. | Building travel tech products. |
| | **OpenSky API** | Real‑time flight data (not booking). | Flight tracking and analytics. |
| | **Skyscanner API** | Search and price comparison. | Embedding flight search into websites. |
| | **Google Flights API** (via Google Travel) | Flight search and price insights. | Integrating flight data into apps. |
| | **FlightStats API** | Flight status, delays, and historical data. | Flight monitoring services. |
| | **FlightAware API** | Real‑time flight tracking. | Tracking flights in real time. |
| | **Travelpayouts API** | Affiliate flight booking and revenue sharing. | Monetizing flight searches. |
| | **Kayak API** | Flight search and price alerts. | Embedding Kayak search into apps. |
| | **Skyscanner Affiliate API** | Earn commissions on bookings. | Affiliate marketing. |
| | **Google Maps API** (for flight route visualization) | Visualize flight paths on maps. | Data visualization. |
| | **FlightRadar24 API** | Real‑time flight data. | Flight tracking dashboards. |
| | **OpenFlights API** | Flight route data. | Aviation research. |

### How to choose the right tool

| Goal | Recommended Tool(s) |
|------|---------------------|
| **Quick price comparison** | Google Flights, Skyscanner, Kayak, Momondo |
| **Best for loyalty points** | Book directly on the airline’s site or use an OTA that partners with your frequent‑flyer program |
| **Lowest price for budget carriers** | Airline direct sites (e.g., Southwest, Ryanair) or aggregator sites that list low‑cost carriers (e.g., Skyscanner, CheapOair) |
| **Multi‑city or complex itineraries** | Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport, Kiwi.com |
| **Real‑time flight status** | FlightRadar24, FlightAware, FlightStats |
| **Automated booking for developers** | Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport, Skyscanner API, Kiwi.com API |
| **Affiliate marketing** | Skyscanner Affiliate, Travelpayouts, Kayak Affiliate |
